output.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog bugfix title [ev-9e6400e3f91e]. It says compareWith is now set correctly for delayed app refreshes, but it doesn't say what operators saw before or whether they will notice any difference afterwards. The surrounding Bug fixes section adds nothing about this change, and four of five proposers left the consequence undetermined. To choose between behavior-change and none, we need the issue #18998 or PR #21298 description of what the wrong compareWith did (for example, refreshes not doing the expected comparison).
